dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: They called my case. I'm going to Hell, and honestly? I'm looking forward to the company.

dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: You and me, we understood each other. Nobody else here ever did.

dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: Pour one out for me. Not the good stuff. Never the good stuff.
